# Footnotes

A reference[^a] in text, a second one[^b], and the first again[^a].

| Table | Cell |
|-------|------|
| a     | with a note[^c] |

> A quote with a note[^b].

A reference without a note[^none] stays text, and a note that nothing
refers to is left out.

[^c]: Written first, referred to last.

[^b]: The second note has `code` and a [link](https://example.com).

[^a]: The first note,
    on two lines.

    And a second paragraph.

[^unused]: Nothing refers to this one.
